headline: 本周影视速览：热片新剧齐发
summary: 电影方面，《猫鼬》《邪灵苏醒》等热作领跑，待映片单有《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》；剧集方面，《夜行杀机》《末路兼职》《完美的谎言》本周首播，《侠探杰克》《梦魇绝镇》持续热播。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《猫鼬》《邪灵苏醒》《极速：伪装者》等受关注。
industryHighlights.en: Movie heat: Mongoose, Evil Awakens, Speed: Impostor and more draw attention.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《夜行杀机》《末路兼职》《完美的谎言》本周上线。
industryHighlights.en: New series: Night Killer, Desperate Part-Time and Perfect Lie premiere this week.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《侠探杰克》《梦魇绝镇》《水晶湖》等持续热播。
industryHighlights.en: Hot series: Reacher, From and Crystal Lake remain popular.

industryHighlights.text: 待映大片：《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》《饥饿游戏：收获日出》蓄势待发。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming: Avengers 5, Dune 3 and The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping are poised.

headlineEn: This Week in Film & TV: Hot Movies, New Series
summaryEn: In film, Mongoose, Evil Awakens and other hot titles lead, while upcoming releases include Avengers 5 and Dune 3; on TV, Night Killer, Desperate Part-Time and Perfect Lie premiere this week, with Reacher and From still trending.
